result.description: A fictional desktop archival docking system designed for studio backup, lab media staging, and long-term cold storage. The ArcPod Nebula combines a tamper-resistant aluminum enclosure with dual-bay hot-swap support, hardware encryption, and quiet active cooling for sustained throughput over USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Thunderbolt-compatible hosts. Includes status telemetry, auto-versioned snapshot support, and a sealed power module for secure offline operation.
result.title: LumenVale ArcPod Nebula 14TB DockVault
